01.title: 俯瞰：グループのリスクマップ
01.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic shot, eight seconds. Begin exactly from the provided first frame: a near-future office at dusk, a Japanese male auditor around 40 with short black hair and thin dark rectangular glasses, charcoal knit over a white shirt collar, seated before a wide dark glass display that shows a three-dimensional network map of glowing teal nodes with one amber node near the center and translucent cards with abstract bars on the right. The network slowly rotates a few degrees in depth with gentle parallax, thin connection lines pulse softly, the amber node brightens and emits one soft ripple, and the side cards update their abstract bars. He leans slightly forward and lifts his right hand from the desk toward the amber node. Only the back and partial profile of his head are visible, mouth closed. Slow steady camera push-in. Realistic reflections on the glass, city skyline defocused. No readable text, no numbers, no subtitles, no logos, no extra people, no cuts.

08.title: 継続：承認、そして翌朝へ
08.prompt: Continue seamlessly from the provided first frame, eight seconds, photorealistic. Seen from behind, the three people stand before the glass wall display with the collaborative board. The older Japanese man in the navy suit on the right raises a thin tablet and taps one large teal confirmation element; the board on the wall responds: the sticky-note cards and the list fold away and the group network map returns, its amber node sending out a soft ripple with a short progress line beneath it. Then the room light changes like a gentle timelapse, from afternoon to night with city lights, and on to fresh cool morning; the three people fade out of the frame during the night, leaving the empty space; in the morning light the former amber node has faded to pale teal and a different node at the edge softly turns amber with two tiny badge dots nearby. Slow camera push toward the wall. Backs only while people are visible, no faces. No readable text, no numbers, no subtitles, no logos, no cuts.
